messages:
Riley: dropping a new draft for the latency & throughput panels. main questions: dynamic unit switching and how to indicate clipped peaks. https://img.redwood/mockups/panel_v3.png :mag:
Maya: nice layout. on units: can we auto-scale units per series (ms / s / k/s) but keep a persistent unit label in the legend so tooltip always has context?
Omar: yes to auto-scale. but UX trap: when units change mid-range users get confused. propose a subtle unit badge that fades in when series changes scale (e.g., "k/s") with an explainer on hover.
Priya: for clipped peaks, prefer a small caret icon + numeric badge rather than just capping. we should also allow expansion: click caret -> expand mini-popup with exact datapoint and link to raw log.
Riley: nice. accessibility: caret must be keyboard focusable and expose aria-expanded and aria-describedby that references the popup text. Also make sure the popup content is accessible via screen reader navigation.
DesignBot: accessibility checklist updated: https://intra.redwood/a11y/checklist v2  Added unit badges as live regions and overflow popups tabbable.
Maya: copy nit for unit badge tooltip: "Data scaled to most readable units. Hover for exact value." keep it short.
Omar: on smoothing: suggest inline preview toggle in the legend item (tiny slider) so users can toggle smoothing per-series quickly. default off.
Priya: agree. also add a visual cue when smoothing is on: dotted outline on the line and a small label "smoothed" for screen readers.
Riley: implementation sketch:
```
seriesConfig = {
  units: { mode: 'auto', legendLabel: 'long', badge: true },
  overflow: { indicator: 'caret', popup: true, keyboard: true },
  smoothing: { default: false, perSeriesToggle: true }
}
```
This will need an aria-live update when units change.
Maya: concerning decimals: show 2 decimals for values <100, 0 decimals for >=100. avoids visual clutter.
Omar: color/contrast: ensure series colors keep 4.5:1 against the background even when dimmed. add a11y token set to the design tokens doc.
Priya: table view request: make the table have a "peak" column with a visual marker and the exact value. screen readers should be able to sort by peak.
Riley: DECISIONS: dynamic auto-scaling units with persistent legend label + hover badge; overflow caret with expandable popup and keyboard focus; smoothing off by default with per-series toggle; decimal rules; ensure contrast tokens. i'll turn this into a short RFC and ping @eng-visuals.
DesignBot: created RFC #210: "panel viz: dynamic units, overflow caret popup, per-series smoothing" https://github.com/redwood/rfcs/210
Maya: i'll mock the caret popup tomorrow and try the badge animation. thanks everyone!
